title: ChatGPT work is down: Could not resolve host: github.com
excerpt: Am I the only one? Started a new work chat in ChatGPT to work on my public GitHub project, it reports:
content_html:
Am I the only one? Started a new work chat in ChatGPT to work on my public GitHub project, it reports:

    fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/':
    Could not resolve host: github.com

Edit: I dropped (deleted) the chat and created a new one - now it's working.
